title: Source-register entry
description: A source pinned, when it is a git object, to a repository, a repository-relative path, a commit, and a blob SHA, with a declared review_scope. source_role records what kind of source this is so a catalogue transcription, an independent manuscript-image transcription, and a critical edition cannot be cited as though they were each other. witness_siglum may only be filled when the cited edition itself assigns that siglum and a locator into that edition is recorded; no siglum is assigned by this repository.

repository.description: Required whenever the source is git-pinned (commit or blob_sha present): the repository that commit belongs to. The path is relative to that repository. A commit from one repository must not be paired with a path that exists only in another.

path.description: Repository-relative path of a git-pinned object, used together with repository, commit, and blob_sha.

source_role.description: What this source is. A catalogue transcription, our own independent manuscript-image transcription, and a critical edition are distinct roles and are never treated as substitutes for one another.

independence_from.description: Source ids that this source derives from or is not independent of. A transcription made from an edition is not independent of that edition and must name it here.

witness_siglum.description: Optional. May only be filled when the cited edition itself assigns this siglum to this witness, and the entry records a locator into that edition for the assignment. No siglum is assigned by this repository, and none may be inferred from the mere presence of a manuscript in an edition.

witness_siglum_locator.description: Required whenever witness_siglum is present: the page or section of the citing edition where the siglum is assigned.

note.description: Optional free-text note about the source's role or limitations. Not a locator field.
